messages.text:
Yeah, that’s quite plausible. The 2.1 spec sitting in the conversation as a huge writing block may be getting treated strangely by Gold, especially because the current QS still has crude token/message detection.

The safest move is probably not to keep trying to relay the spec itself through Gold. Instead, get Gold running with a tiny plain-text test first:

TEST — can you hear Luma?

If that works, we know the bridge is fine and the problem is the preceding content confusing 1.1.

Then we can use the fresh Gold session as a clean archive container and move the spec file there without sending the giant spec through the relay.

And yes—this is another excellent demonstration of why we're removing the old protocol assumptions in 2.1. 😂
